scope: Segment 103 field-level rules, serialization, applicability, WIC/eWIC element structure, and EBT program-data structure

rules.title: Segment 103 is a Data Section 3 companion segment usable in any Data Section 3 field slot
Segment 103 is required when the transaction flow needs EBT-specific data
Segment Type is 103
Segment Length is 3 or 4 digits; 4 digits is required for EBT-with-eWIC transactions
Segment 103 maximum length is 3,334 alphanumeric characters
Field order matches Section 12.4 (Segment Type, Segment Length, Clerk ID, Voucher ID, WIC Discount Amount, WIC Product Data, EBT Program Data)
Request serialization: every Segment 103 field is separated by a Field Separator, including empty fields
Response serialization: there is no Field Separator between Segment 103 fields
Clerk ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Voucher ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
WIC Discount Amount uses the positional format Account Type(97) + Amount Type(52) + Currency Code + signed Amount
WIC Discount Amount maximum length is 40 bytes, composed of one or more 20-byte positional blocks
WIC Product Data is bounded to 3,001 bytes and begins with a 4-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 2997
EBT Program Data is bounded to 267 bytes and begins with a 3-digit Total Length subelement with maximum value 264
EBT Program Data contains 1 to 6 Program Data subelements, each bounded to 44 bytes
EBT Program Data subelement TAG must be one of the documented values (50, IT for requests; 51, 52 for responses)
EBT Program Data subelement with TAG 50 requires ACCOUNT TYPE fixed value 98 (not required when TAG is IT)
Segment 103 appears exactly once per message
Segment 103 originates at the device
eWIC does not support Return transactions
eWIC operations use a recognized prompt-code set (3086, S086, E086, 0086, 8086) carried in the companion Segment 100 Prompt Code
